name: tgrep

reviews.looked_at: README architecture (trigram index + JSON-RPC serve), AGENTS.md client contract (--json, -- before pattern, exit 1 is no match), v1.0.8 release assets for macOS/Linux/Windows.
reviews.because: vv-code-search wraps the binary as the lexical discovery engine. Not a git submodule: the gem execs tgrep on PATH (VV_TGREP override). Adapter waits until we build from source rather than follow the release binary.

maturity: v1.0.8. CLI + library crates. Used as a PATH binary by gems/vv-code-search.
notes: Follow, do not fork. Declared pin, not a gitlink -- check_reversible_pins skips submodule round-trip for kind=declared. Advance via pinned_version + rollback_target. gems/vv-code-search is the only consumer; it must not vendor tgrep-core.
